title: A stale feedback.ids takeover guard is removed by path, so a live guard can be deleted and two takers hold the lock
goal: ql_capture._take_stale_ids_lock removes a stale takeover guard only while it still holds the remover's own token, so two takers never both hold feedback.ids.lock when a dead taker left its guard
repro_reason: a race of eight threads over a dead guard: three of a hundred rounds gave two holders in the reviewer's measurement, so no single run fails every time
notes: Found by the SP-osevumx6 review. The repro is a stub that always fails: the race is probabilistic. Reproduce with a dead lock file and a dead takeover guard file, both aged 100 s, then 8 threads calling ql_capture._take_ids_lock on the lock with FEEDBACK_IDS_LOCK_WAIT_S=0.3, 100 rounds: about 3 rounds give two holders. Replace the stub by a planted loop check when this is taken up. Left out of SP-wjrxikw6 2026-11-10: the race has no single-run failing repro yet; a planted case needs the fix's design (token compare or rename), so plan it with that choice made.
